About me

The people side of the numbers

I’m Mahin, a compensation and benefits specialist in Dhaka with 4+ years in HR, now working as an HR generalist at Fin.com.

In Bangladesh, payroll covers every money matter between a company and its people, and that’s where I’m strongest: CTC calculations, incentives, performance appraisals, insurance, Provident Fund and gratuity, and payroll income tax. I’ve handled pay negotiations up to Deputy Manager level, prepared appointment letters and trained teams on HRIS at Navana Group and Apex Footwear.

At Fin.com, my work covers the whole employee experience, from keeping morale high to running the canteen, managing inventory and decorating the office.

My background mixes numbers and people: a BBA in Accounting and Human Resource Management from East West University, and an Executive MBA in Organization Strategy & Leadership from the University of Dhaka. Off the clock, you’ll find me hunting down good food or exploring a new country, ten days at a time.
